Name: Kenneth's Drink Your Milk Before Going to Bed
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Drink Your Milk Before Going to Bed[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A little bedtime snack every night. Get 1 Glass Bottle of Milk and 1 Bag of Chocolate Chip Cookies between 9PM and 9:59PM, free, once a day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Every night, you get a small snack for bedtime. 1 Glass Bottle of Milk and 1 Bag of Chocolate Chip Cookies, straight to your inventory. No shop, no gold, no crafting, just a quiet little treat before you call it a night.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Between 9PM and 9:59PM, walk to a different area, like going inside, outside, or to another map. That is when the snack shows up. It only happens once a day, then it resets the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]After 10PM, no more snacks. It is bedtime.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Keep playing like normal until 9PM.[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]• Walk to a different area between 9PM and 9:59PM.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]• Check your inventory for your milk and cookies.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]• Drink your milk before going to bed.[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Grocery Store - you need this, the milk and cookies come from there[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Grocery Store is also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and play until 9PM.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. It just gives you a snack at night, nothing else changes. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Mod by Kenneth[/b][/size]
